chapters.title: Merge one row at a time, keeping k

sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — calls <genexpr>()
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 1; s = 0; v = 1
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 3; v = 3
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 11; v = 11
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row))
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields None
for row in mat: — sums is now [1, 3, 11]; row is now [2, 4, 6]

sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 3; s = 1; v = 2
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 5; v = 4
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 7; v = 6

sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 5; s = 3; v = 2
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 7; v = 4
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 9; v = 6
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row))
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 13; s = 11; v = 2
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 15; v = 4
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields 17; v = 6
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row))
sums = heapq.nsmallest(k, (s + v for s in sums for v in row)) — yields None

chapters.title: Best-first search over index tuples

frames.caption: Best-first search over index tuples — O(k · m log k) time, O(k · m) extra space. Input: kth_smallest(mat=[[1, 3, 11], [2, 4, 6]], k=5). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
first = sum(row[0] for row in mat) — calls <genexpr>()
first = sum(row[0] for row in mat) — yields 1; row = [1, 3, 11]
first = sum(row[0] for row in mat) — yields 2; row is now [2, 4, 6]
first = sum(row[0] for row in mat) — yields None
total, idx = heapq.heappop(heap) — (3, (0, 0)) popped off the end of heap; total = 3; idx = (0, 0)
total, idx = heapq.heappop(heap) — (5, (0, 1)) taken from the front of heap; total = 5; idx[1] becomes 1
total, idx = heapq.heappop(heap) — heap is now [(7, (0, 2)), (7, (1, 1))]; swap idx[0] and idx[1]
total, idx = heapq.heappop(heap) — (7, (0, 2)) taken from the front of heap; total = 7; idx is now (0, 2)
